verdict.rationale: Hightouch transforms and filters data before it reaches destinations through warehouse-side models built with SQL, dbt, or a visual builder, with field mapping in syncs and Match Booster adding identifiers. However, Events is documented as landing raw behavior data in the warehouse, with logic moving there, rather than offering in-flight event transformation functions. Missing for 10: custom code/functions applied to events in-stream before delivery, real-time event filtering/enrichment in the event pipeline, and hands-on corroboration of transformation workflows.
